name: Name
topic_01_1: PPE must be worn as required at all times on site.
topic_01_2: General PPE: Safety Helmet, Safety Vest, Safety Shoes.
topic_01_3: Work at height: Full Body Harness.
topic_01_4: Working over water or on boats: Life Jacket.
topic_01_5: Chemical work: Rubber Gloves, Mask, Safety Goggles.
topic_01_6: Hot work: Welding Gloves, Welding Face Shield, Welding Clothing.
topic_01_8: Grouting and concrete: Safety Glasses, Dust Mask.
topic_01_9: Lost or damaged PPE must be reported for replacement.
topic_02_1: Do not use equipment, appliances or tools outside the scope of your duties.
topic_02_2: Do not report for work after consuming alcohol or drugs.
topic_02_3: Do not remove scaffolding, safety barriers or safety signs without permission.
topic_02_4: Do not damage site facilities, equipment or project property.
topic_02_5: No smoking in the work area.
topic_02_6: No mobile phones in the work area.
topic_02_11: Follow the site safety management system at all times.
topic_03_1: Follow all instructions from the resort (client) management and report any changes immediately.
topic_03_2: Stay out of guest areas unless authorised. Be polite and discreet near guests.
topic_03_3: Protect wildlife, vegetation and the environment.
topic_03_4: Comply with local laws and regulations.
topic_03_6: Do not leave the accommodation at night without permission.
topic_03_7: Do not take part in demonstrations.
topic_03_8: Do not get into conflicts with outsiders.
topic_04_1: In an emergency, follow site personnel and gather at the assembly point.
topic_04_2: Electric shock: cut the power first. If you cannot, separate the person from the wire with a wooden stick or other insulated tool.
topic_04_3: Fire you cannot put out: evacuate calmly by the safe route.
topic_04_4: Heat stroke: move the person to a cool place, loosen tight clothing and wipe the body with a wet towel.
topic_04_5: If a rod or sharp object pierces the body, do not remove it. Keep it still and wait for help.
topic_04_6: If you feel unwell, stop work and tell the engineer on duty.
topic_04_7: Report any injury immediately to the site engineer, safety officer and supervisor.
topic_05_1: Working over water or on boats: risk of drowning, falls and slips. Life jacket is mandatory during boat transfers. Use safe access.
topic_05_2: Diving and underwater work: only trained and authorised divers. Follow approved diving and emergency procedures.
topic_05_3: Working at height: use approved scaffolding, guardrails and fall protection.
topic_05_4: Lifting: keep clear of suspended loads and follow the lifting plan.
topic_05_5: Fire and electrical: follow hot-work rules, use inspected equipment, keep extinguishers ready.
topic_05_6: Tools and machinery: trained operators only. Keep exclusion zones.
topic_05_7: Weather and sea: stop work in unsafe wind, waves or lightning.
topic_05_8: Environment: keep fuel, chemicals, concrete, waste and debris out of the lagoon.
topic_05_9: Stop work: anyone may stop work if conditions are unsafe. Report to the supervisor or safety officer immediately.
topic_06_1: Rule breaches lead to graded action: recorded verbal warning, first written warning, final written warning, removal from site.
topic_06_2: Do not touch, damage or step on coral. No fishing or harming marine life in the lagoon.
topic_06_3: Assaulting or threatening anyone on site means immediate removal from site and may be reported to the police.
topic_06_4: Working under alcohol or drugs, fighting or theft means immediate removal from site.
